text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho had arrived. Tosen 
Jordan's hoof was barely holding together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And yet, she had truly made it to this 
stage. To a once-in-a-lifetime showdown 
competing against her peers. And Nakayama 
Festa was surprised to see her appear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
People say the Oka Sho is generating the 
most buzz. Yet she laughs, saying that 
with Tosen Jordan in the mix, the dice 
have been rolled anew.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I wouldn't mind if it all ended here." 
Tosen Jordan, who should have been 
prepared for that, felt her heart waver 
just a little.
